source.note: Hard-coded counts from the live API. Same shape as embed_figures.json.

figures.label: Preprints
figures.info: Preprints by Wellcome-funded researchers or Wellcome authors, by publication date.

preprint_growth.source: is_preprint counts from the live API on 10 Nov 2026 by published_date, 1 Jan to 10 Nov of each year.

share.label: Policy compliance
share.info: Original research articles covered by the policy with their full text in Europe PMC under a CC BY, CC0 or public domain license, or an approved CC BY-ND license. Preprints with a CC BY license also count.

figures.label: Journal articles
figures.info: Journal articles funded by Wellcome or written by Wellcome authors, by publication date.

figures.label: Free to read
figures.info: Journal articles that anyone can read for free, from the publisher, a repository or as a preprint.

figures.label: Open access
figures.info: Journal articles with a CC BY, CC0 or public domain license from the publisher, a repository or the preprint.

compliance.source: Counted from the live API on 10 Nov 2026 by published_date, 1 Jan to 10 Nov of each year. Compliant and not compliant add up to covered in both periods.

share.label: Virology articles with a preprint
share.info: Virology articles covered by the policy that also have a preprint. Subjects come from OpenAlex.

figures.label: Outbreak research
figures.info: Articles on outbreaks covered by the policy that also have a preprint.

figures.label: Tuberculosis research
figures.info: Tuberculosis articles covered by the policy that also have a preprint.

figures.label: Malaria research
figures.info: Malaria articles covered by the policy that also have a preprint.

figures.label: All subjects
figures.info: All articles covered by the policy that also have a preprint.

preprints_public_health.source: Counted from the live API on 10 Nov 2026 by published_date, 1 Jan to 10 Nov 2026. “With preprint” is supplements.has_preprint_copy, as in the subject breakdown on oa.report/wellcome. No comparison: no subject rises steadily year on year.

hero.label: Data availability statements in 2025
hero.info: Journal articles with a data availability statement, as a share of the journal articles we’ve reviewed for one.

das_share.caption: Share of reviewed journal articles with a data availability statement, by year
das_share.source: has_data_availability_statement over has_checked_data_availability_statement, from the live API on 10 Nov 2026. 2026 is left out because articles are still being reviewed.
